description:
MOTOR The Performance Line is the 75Nm, 600W motor, perfect for trekking. It provides a powerful, even boost when starting, making it easier to get going at traffic lights, for example. Its robust design requires no additional maintenance, even with intensive use, making it ideal for everyday use, even in windy and inclement weather. DRUMS PowerTube 600 is the 600 Wh battery, lightweight and perfectly integrated into the frame, ideal for medium distances. DISPLAY The Purion 200 is a handlebar-mounted control unit with an integrated display. This all-in-one solution with a color display, which neatly clutters the handlebars, sits directly next to the thumb and offers a clear view of riding data and simple, ergonomic control of all functions. More connected and personalized With the eBike Flow app, you can connect your smartphone to your BE23 for a better, more connected, safer, and more personalized riding experience. You can customize assistance modes, adjust the drive unit's performance parameters, update your e-bike, access the owner's manual, and use the navigation function.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES The BE23 BERLINO is a trekking bike with a 600 Wh battery, ideal for those who love to travel comfortably on two wheels. Equipped with a 75 Nm Bosch Performance Line motor, it offers a natural and quiet ride, perfect for urban routes and beyond. The motor automatically adapts to provide optimal support in every riding situation, delivering up to 340% of your physical performance. The aluminum frame combines lightness and strength, without sacrificing design and finish. The Bosch PowerTube 600 battery is fully integrated into the frame for a clean and modern design. The standard equipment includes all the ideal accessories for medium- to long-range trips, such as a double rack, fenders, and lights. IDEAL FOR BE 23 BERLIN is designed for all daily home-work journeys, but also for Sunday rides on dirt roads and medium-range dirt roads. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you're looking for a comfortable and versatile e-bike that can accompany you on your daily journeys in complete comfort, with effective support and quality mechanics.
